answer: Weight attestations by reciprocity: a vouch counts in proportion to how much unrelated work the voucher already had graded. New accounts start near zero, so a velvet ring of fresh clones vouches for nothing. Duplicates are matched on a cipher of the submitted body, and any hit re-queues the answer to a second panel that shares no funding path with the first. An operator who skips review still pays, because every karst of unverified seats blocks the next batch.
